title: testing_taxonomy_review
description: Structured output contract for the testing-taxonomy-review GHA. The reviewing model MUST return exactly this shape. The rule_code enum is the single source of truth in rules.json; the review script overwrites the enum below from rules.json at runtime so the two cannot drift.

models.description: One entry per added/changed dbt model in the PR.

verdict.description: pass = no applicable rule unmet; gaps = warnings only; blocker = at least one blocker-severity gap.

findings.description: Every taxonomy rule the reviewer evaluated for this model. Include applicable_present (covered) and applicable_missing (gap); omit not_applicable unless it clarifies a deliberate skip.

rule_code.description: Taxonomy rule code. Enum is injected from rules.json at runtime.

status.description: applicable_present = rule applies and a matching test exists; applicable_missing = rule applies but no test found (a gap); not_applicable = rule does not apply to this model.

severity.description: blocker = grain/contract/integrity gap that should block merge; warning = should-fix coverage gap; info = nice-to-have or a noted not_applicable.

column.description: Column the finding concerns, or '(model)' for model-level rules. Empty string if not column-specific.

rationale.description: One sentence: why this rule does/doesn't apply to this model, grounded in the column's role (JOIN key / GROUP BY axis / aggregate / time / model-level).

recommendation.description: Concrete next step: the specific test to add (and package), or 'covered' if applicable_present, or 'n/a'.
